snippet.title: Transmission: Shortwave Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/transmission-shortwave/3547956195215144/

A life-changing experience is about to begin! You have been chosen to become a ParcelPal franchisee for me, Percival Parse of ParcelPal PLC (a Pal-Co partnership)! Become your own boss and deliver as quickly or casually as you'd like through the most impressive display of 1990s technology. Experience retro-futuristic landscapes inspired by real-world areas across the UK that react to an original soundtrack inspired by early electronic dance music. With hundreds of customisable options, deliver and ride in style on the journey to financial independence! 

Kind Regards, Percival Parse.

Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/4yG8MeKAcB
